as_of.description: show the graph as it was valid on this date (ISO-8601); a related node outside its validity interval is hidden. Timeless nodes are always shown. Filters the surrounding related nodes only, not the anchor `node` itself.

n.description: chunk number, exactly as shown in `[#n]` in a search result

node.description: reasoning-node id from a `glossary` line (e.g. `sym:...`) — call after glossary to find alternate/similar cases

path.description: document path, exactly as shown in a search result (use with `n` instead of `node`)
